label: 1. Raman ref
library: reference axis: diagnostic band library v1.0 (17 classes, 187 bands, 67 key), ranking rule and evidence floor; a reproducible rule, not a verified ground truth

label: 2. SLoPP
library: SLoPP and SLoPP-E Raman libraries: references covering >=90% of the 300-3200 cm-1 grid and assigned before matching to one of 7 band-library classes (Code 1 CLASS_MAP, Sections 12-4 and 15); Code 1 preprocessing; the Open Specy software was not used

label: 3. spec_class
library: in-house rule engine (framework v1.0, parameter set p1): 11-class vocabulary frozen from 198 site spectra, or an abstention state

label: 4. omnic_name
library: OMNIC 9.11.745 library search (correlation, 748-3302 cm-1) over 23 commercial libraries (ESI Table S4); hit name as returned

label: 5. OS_cor
library: Open Specy derivative reference library restricted to its FT-IR spectra (A3), match_spec correlation

label: 6. OS_ml
library: Open Specy model_derivative FT-IR multinomial classifier (26 classes), ai_classify on the classifier wavenumber axis

label: 7. siMPle
library: siMPle "Single spectra IR" reference library v1.02 (references spanning the common grid, A4a), match_spec as stream 5; the siMPle software, which targets FPA imaging maps, was not run
